svg.title: πMPC vs Standard ADMM — horizon decomposition
svg.text: Standard ADMM vs πMPC — horizon decomposition (N=8)
Switch solver to compare serial Riccati chain with parallel independent workers. Select CPU cores to see multi-core πMPC parallelism.

g.text: Standard ADMM — two blocks per iteration
Block 1 (SERIAL) — Riccati backward sweep: k=N−1 first, k=0 last
Each stage waits for k+1 to finish — serial critical path of length N
Block 2 (PARALLEL) — project each z_k and v_k independently
Parallel projection does NOT fix the serial bottleneck — Block 1 dominates
Frozen previous iterate — extrapolated momentum variables with Nesterov
worker k reads adjacent iterate columns k+1 and k+2: ẑₖ₊₁, ẑₖ₊₂, v̂ₖ, v̂ₖ₊₁, θ̂ₖ, β̂ₖ, λ̂ₖ, λ̂ₖ₊₁ — no live i+1 data

g.data-tip: k=0: reads ẑ₁,v̂₀,v̂₁,θ̂₀,β̂₀,λ̂₀,λ̂₁ (frozen). Writes Δu₀,x̄₁,z₁,v₀,θ₀,β₀,λ₀ — column 0 only.
g.text: Δu₀ x̄₁ z₁ v₀ θ₀ β₀ λ₀

g.data-tip: k=1: reads ẑ₂,v̂₁,v̂₂,θ̂₁,β̂₁,λ̂₁,λ̂₂ (frozen). Writes Δu₁,x̄₂,z₂,v₁,θ₁,β₁,λ₁ — column 1 only.
g.text: Δu₁ x̄₂ z₂ v₁ θ₁ β₁ λ₁

g.data-tip: k=2: reads ẑ₃,v̂₂,v̂₃,θ̂₂,β̂₂,λ̂₂,λ̂₃ (frozen). Writes Δu₂,x̄₃,z₃,v₂,θ₂,β₂,λ₂ — column 2 only.
g.text: Δu₂ x̄₃ z₃ v₂ θ₂ β₂ λ₂

g.data-tip: k=3: reads ẑ₄,v̂₃,v̂₄,θ̂₃,β̂₃,λ̂₃,λ̂₄ (frozen). Writes Δu₃,x̄₄,z₄,v₃,θ₃,β₃,λ₃ — column 3 only.
g.text: Δu₃ x̄₄ z₄ v₃ θ₃ β₃ λ₃

g.data-tip: k=4: reads ẑ₅,v̂₄,v̂₅,θ̂₄,β̂₄,λ̂₄,λ̂₅ (frozen). Writes Δu₄,x̄₅,z₅,v₄,θ₄,β₄,λ₄ — column 4 only.
g.text: Δu₄ x̄₅ z₅ v₄ θ₄ β₄ λ₄

g.data-tip: k=5: reads ẑ₆,v̂₅,v̂₆,θ̂₅,β̂₅,λ̂₅,λ̂₆ (frozen). Writes Δu₅,x̄₆,z₆,v₅,θ₅,β₅,λ₅ — column 5 only.
g.text: Δu₅ x̄₆ z₆ v₅ θ₅ β₅ λ₅

g.data-tip: k=6: reads ẑ₇,v̂₆,v̂₇,θ̂₆,β̂₆,λ̂₆,λ̂₇ (frozen). Writes Δu₆,x̄₇,z₇,v₆,θ₆,β₆,λ₆ — column 6 only.
g.text: Δu₆ x̄₇ z₇ v₆ θ₆ β₆ λ₆

g.data-tip: k=7: reads ẑ₈,v̂₇,v̂₈,θ̂₇,β̂₇,λ̂₇,λ̂₈ (frozen). Writes Δu₇,x̄₈,z₈,v₇,θ₇,β₇,λ₇ — column 7 only.
g.text: Δu₇ x̄₈ z₈ v₇ θ₇ β₇ λ₇
All N workers finish → Nesterov forms ẑ,v̂,θ̂,β̂,λ̂ → frozen for iteration i+1
* illustrative relative rates — actual rates depend on ρ and problem data

svg.text: πMPC GPU — all 8 workers run simultaneously
No mathematical coupling between stages. O(1) wall-clock per iteration, independent of N.

g.text: ① The key copy: vₖ = B̄ₖΔuₖ (not vₖ = uₖ)
Without: vₖ=uₖ → B̄ₖ stays in dynamics → step k waits for k+1 → Riccati chain
With πMPC: vₖ=B̄ₖΔuₖ → zₖ₊₁=Āₖx̄ₖ+vₖ+ēₖ → step k reads only frozen values
Result: Δuₖ subproblem is a pure quadratic → closed form Δuₖ=Jₖ(v̂ₖ−β̂ₖ)
② Three constraints, one dual each
④ CPU multi-core: same algorithm, more hardware parallelism
Standard ADMM: k waits for k+1 — cannot parallelise regardless of cores
πMPC CPU (M cores): ceil(N/M) rounds — with M≥N identical to GPU
